images.filename: 20150708 - 27 - Pukaskwa National Park, Ont. - welcome sign.jpg
images.caption: The welcome sign at the entrance to Pukaskwa National Park in Ontario, Canada, as seen on a July 2015 afternoon. By far the largest national park in the province, this 725-square-mile expanse was established in 1978 to protect the majestic boreal forests and rocky shorelines of Lake Superior, a crown jewel of the longest undeveloped shoreline anywhere on the Great Lakes. It's a destination for hikers, campers, boaters, and wildlife spotters.
images.alt: The welcome sign at the entrance to Pukaskwa National Park in Ontario, Canada, as seen on a July 2015 afternoon.
